exhibits.title: Mona Lisa
exhibits.description: A softly modeled portrait whose enigmatic expression and atmospheric landscape exemplify Leonardo's sfumato technique.

exhibits.title: The School of Athens
exhibits.description: Ancient philosophers gather in an idealized architectural space celebrating reason, mathematics and inquiry.

exhibits.title: Lady with an Ermine
exhibits.description: A young woman turns while holding an ermine, combining psychological presence with graceful movement.

exhibits.title: The Annunciation (San Marco fresco)
exhibits.description: Gabriel kneels before Mary beneath a simple arcaded loggia. The spare architecture, quiet gestures and soft color create a contemplative devotional scene.

exhibits.title: The Last Supper
exhibits.description: Christ announces his impending betrayal at a communal meal, while the apostles respond with dramatically varied gestures.

exhibits.title: Primavera
exhibits.description: Mythological figures assemble in a richly detailed grove, evoking spring, love and renewal.

exhibits.title: Sistine Madonna
exhibits.description: The Virgin and Child appear among clouds, accompanied by saints and two famous cherubs.

exhibits.title: The Lamentation
exhibits.description: Mourners gather around Christ's body in an emotionally direct fresco that helped transform European painting.

exhibits.title: The Creation of Adam
exhibits.description: God and Adam reach toward one another in a fresco exploring creation and the origin of human life.

exhibits.title: The Arnolfini Portrait
exhibits.description: A richly furnished domestic interior uses a convex mirror, intricate objects and light to create layers of meaning.

exhibits.title: Venus of Urbino
exhibits.description: A reclining woman meets the viewer's gaze in a richly colored Venetian interior.

exhibits.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
exhibits.description: A young figure turns toward the viewer, with luminous fabric and an oversized pearl-like earring.

exhibits.title: The Milkmaid
exhibits.description: A servant pours milk in a quiet domestic scene distinguished by meticulous observation of light and texture.

exhibits.title: The Storm on the Sea of Galilee
exhibits.description: Christ and his disciples confront a turbulent sea in a dramatic study of faith and human vulnerability.

exhibits.title: The Supper at Emmaus
exhibits.description: Disciples recognize the risen Christ during a meal, their gestures heightening the moment of revelation.

exhibits.title: The Night Watch
exhibits.description: A civic guard company emerges in a dynamic group portrait distinguished by dramatic illumination.

exhibits.title: The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp
exhibits.description: Surgeons gather around a dissected arm, demonstrating anatomical observation and professional learning.

exhibits.title: The Swing
exhibits.description: A young woman swings through a lush garden in a playful scene associated with Rococo elegance.

exhibits.title: The Art of Painting
exhibits.description: An artist paints an allegorical model in a carefully arranged studio, reflecting on the nature of painting.

exhibits.title: The Calling of Saint Matthew
exhibits.description: A shaft of light emphasizes the moment of Matthew's calling in a contemporary-looking interior.

exhibits.title: Judith Beheading Holofernes
exhibits.description: Judith and her maid overpower Holofernes in a dramatic rendering of the biblical story.

exhibits.title: The Elevation of the Cross
exhibits.description: Figures strain to raise the cross in a powerful composition defined by diagonals and muscular movement.

exhibits.title: The Rokeby Venus
exhibits.description: A reclining Venus looks toward a mirror held by Cupid in a study of beauty and reflected vision.

exhibits.title: Wanderer Above the Sea of Fog
exhibits.description: A solitary figure surveys a sea of fog, embodying the Romantic sublime and the unknowable scale of nature.

exhibits.title: The Death of Socrates
exhibits.description: Socrates faces death while continuing to teach, embodying philosophical conviction and intellectual courage.

exhibits.title: The Oath of the Horatii
exhibits.description: Three brothers pledge loyalty before their father, dramatizing civic duty and personal sacrifice.

exhibits.title: The Hay Wain
exhibits.description: A rural wagon crosses a shallow river in a detailed study of the English countryside.

exhibits.title: Liberty Leading the People
exhibits.description: An allegorical figure of Liberty leads revolutionaries over a barricade in a vision of political upheaval.

exhibits.title: Saturn Devouring His Son
exhibits.description: A mythological father consumes his child in a disturbing vision of fear, power and destruction.

exhibits.title: The Death of Marat
exhibits.description: The murdered revolutionary Jean-Paul Marat is depicted in a spare, idealized scene of political martyrdom.

exhibits.title: The Gleaners
exhibits.description: Three women collect leftover grain, making rural labor and social inequality the subject of monumental art.

exhibits.title: The Raft of the Medusa
exhibits.description: Shipwreck survivors struggle toward rescue in a monumental composition exploring suffering and hope.

exhibits.title: The Nightmare
exhibits.description: A sleeping woman and uncanny figures create a haunting meditation on dreams and terror.

exhibits.title: The Fighting Temeraire
exhibits.description: An aging warship is towed toward dismantling as sunset and steam power evoke historical change.

exhibits.title: The Ninth Wave
exhibits.description: Survivors face immense waves beneath a luminous sky in a dramatic image of nature's power.

exhibits.title: The Scream
exhibits.description: An anguished figure stands against a violently colored sky in an enduring image of existential anxiety.

exhibits.title: Café Terrace at Night
exhibits.description: A warmly illuminated café terrace contrasts with the deep blue of an evening street and sky.

exhibits.title: The Night Café
exhibits.description: An intensely colored café interior expresses unease through exaggerated perspective and contrasting hues.

exhibits.title: The Card Players (Musée d’Orsay version)
exhibits.description: Two men sit across a small table playing cards, with a bottle between them. Cézanne builds the composition from restrained color and solid geometric forms. This is the Musée d’Orsay version of the series.

exhibits.title: The Kiss
exhibits.description: Two embracing figures dissolve into intricate gilded ornament in a celebration of intimacy.

exhibits.title: Starry Night Over the Rhône
exhibits.description: Stars and artificial lights shimmer on the Rhône in a nocturnal study of reflected color.

exhibits.title: Wheatfield with Crows
exhibits.description: A turbulent sky, wheat fields and dark birds create a powerful late landscape.

exhibits.title: Impression, Sunrise
exhibits.description: A hazy harbor and orange sun capture the fleeting effect of atmosphere that gave Impressionism its name.

exhibits.title: Sunflowers (National Gallery version)
exhibits.description: A vase of sunflowers in varied stages of bloom stands against a yellow background. This is the 1888 London National Gallery version (NG3863), one of Van Gogh’s series of sunflower still lifes.

exhibits.title: Luncheon of the Boating Party
exhibits.description: Friends gather around a table on a sunny terrace in an intimate study of social life and color.

exhibits.title: Nighthawks
exhibits.description: Late-night customers occupy a brightly lit diner surrounded by an empty urban street.

exhibits.title: American Gothic
exhibits.description: A stern pair stands before a Gothic-windowed house in an iconic image of rural American identity.

exhibits.title: Black Square
exhibits.description: A black square on a pale ground radically reduces painting to a nonrepresentational statement.

exhibits.title: The Great Wave off Kanagawa
exhibits.description: An enormous wave towers over boats and distant Mount Fuji in a celebrated Japanese woodblock print.

exhibits.title: Red Fuji
exhibits.description: Mount Fuji glows red beneath a patterned sky in one of Hokusai's celebrated woodblock views.

exhibits.title: The Tortoise Trainer
exhibits.description: A figure attends to tortoises in a tiled interior, a scene often interpreted in relation to reform and patience.

exhibits.title: Along the River During the Qingming Festival (city gate detail)
exhibits.description: This excerpt from Zhang Zeduan’s Song-dynasty handscroll shows a city gate and the activity surrounding it. The complete scroll traces daily life across rural and urban settings; only one section is reproduced here.

exhibits.title: Red and White Plum Blossoms
exhibits.description: Flowering trees flank a stylized stream across a pair of richly decorative Japanese screens.

exhibits.title: A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains (detail)
exhibits.description: A section of Wang Ximeng’s blue-green landscape handscroll, featuring layered mountain forms, water and inscriptions. The original is a long panoramic composition; this image is an excerpt.

exhibits.title: Shakuntala
exhibits.description: Shakuntala, a heroine of Sanskrit literature, turns back as her companions stand nearby in a wooded setting. The painting evokes the story of her love for King Dushyanta.

exhibits.title: Spoliarium
exhibits.description: Fallen gladiators are dragged into a Roman arena's service area in a monumental image of suffering and injustice.

exhibits.title: The Parisian Life
exhibits.description: A woman sits in a Parisian café near a group of men in an enigmatic scene of metropolitan life.

exhibits.title: Las Virgenes Cristianas Expuestas al Populacho
exhibits.description: Christian women face public humiliation in an academic historical painting of persecution.

exhibits.title: A Philosopher Lecturing on the Orrery
exhibits.description: A group watches a model of the solar system illuminated by an artificial sun, dramatizing Enlightenment curiosity.

exhibits.title: The Astronomer
exhibits.description: A scholar examines a celestial globe in a quiet interior devoted to astronomical study.

exhibits.title: The Alchemist Discovering Phosphorus
exhibits.description: An alchemist encounters luminous phosphorus, making a historical discovery the focus of dramatic illumination.

exhibits.title: The Geographer
exhibits.description: A scholar pauses over maps and instruments in a study of observation and geographical knowledge.

exhibits.title: An Experiment on a Bird in the Air Pump
exhibits.description: Observers respond to an air-pump demonstration, raising questions about experimentation and scientific ethics.

exhibits.title: Portrait of the Lavoisiers
exhibits.description: The chemist Antoine Lavoisier and Marie-Anne Paulze Lavoisier appear with laboratory instruments, emphasizing scientific partnership.

exhibits.title: The School of Athens
exhibits.description: Ancient philosophers gather in an idealized architectural space celebrating reason, mathematics and inquiry.

exhibits.title: Philosopher in Meditation
exhibits.description: A quiet interior with a spiral staircase and a seated figure evokes contemplation; the traditional philosopher title is interpretive.

exhibits.title: The Death of Socrates
exhibits.description: Socrates faces death while continuing to teach, embodying philosophical conviction and intellectual courage.

exhibits.title: Vitruvian Man
exhibits.description: Leonardo's pen-and-ink study places the human body inside a circle and square, connecting anatomy and geometry.

exhibits.title: Newton
exhibits.description: Newton bends over a geometric diagram with a compass, absorbed in measurement. Blake’s image can be read as a critique of a worldview restricted to rational calculation. It is a color print finished by hand, not a conventional oil portrait.

exhibits.title: Wanderer Above the Sea of Fog
exhibits.description: A solitary figure surveys a sea of fog, embodying the Romantic sublime and the unknowable scale of nature.

exhibits.title: The Anatomy Lesson of Dr. Nicolaes Tulp
exhibits.description: Surgeons gather around a dissected arm, demonstrating anatomical observation and professional learning.

exhibits.title: The Gross Clinic
exhibits.description: A surgeon leads an operation before students in a striking representation of medical teaching.

exhibits.title: Portrait of Albert Einstein (1917)
exhibits.description: A historical portrait of Albert Einstein from the years immediately following his formulation of general relativity.

exhibits.title: Albert Einstein (1924)
exhibits.description: Leonid Pasternak's portrait offers an artistic interpretation of Einstein during his years of scientific prominence.

exhibits.title: Isaac Newton
exhibits.description: A portrait of the mathematician and physicist whose laws of motion and gravitation shaped classical mechanics.

exhibits.title: Nikola Tesla (Blue Portrait)
exhibits.description: A portrait of the inventor known for contributions to alternating-current power and electrical engineering.
